title: Wayne's World 2
tagline: Waynestock is on. So is dinner.
about: Wayne and Garth try to put on a giant rock festival in Aurora after a vision tells them to.
cue: Serve the snacks when Waynestock kicks off.
faces: A dream told me to put on a concert, so Garth's doing catering. It's mostly chips and dip, but the dip is excellent.
Fried doughnut balls tossed in cinnamon sugar.
Grilled corn with chilli lime butter.
Seven layer dip with corn chips
Book them and they will come.
Deep dish pizza with mozzarella, Italian sausage and tomato sauce.
Backstage choc cookie ice cream sandwiches
Chocolate cookies sandwiching vanilla ice cream, edges in sprinkles.
Lemon and raspberry slush, tart and icy.
Milwaukee lager in a plastic cup
For Del Preston, roadie to every band ever.
Serve the snacks when Waynestock kicks off.
Back in five. Maybe ten. Prices subject to change. Kiosk licence 1993.
